_notes: Phase 0 reference texture tiles for the parametric-factory port. Each material id maps to a folder
tinted:true materials store a NEUTRAL, luminance-normalised grey `color` tile (mean 0.72, exactly
furniture_lib.py's tinted_fabric() recipe: lum = px . [0.2126,0.7152,0.0722]; lum = lum/lum.mean()*0.72;
clip 0..1) — the live app is expected to multiply this by a runtime colour (baseColorFactor), matching
how every one of these scripts renders colour variants today. tinted:false materials keep their diffuse as-is.
normal and roughness maps are never tinted and are kept as-is (just resized/re-encoded) for every material.
sourceFiles are read-only originals under assets/furniture/**/inputs/materials/ (Poly Haven CC0) or, for the
bed, scratch PNGs baked by build-bed-benchmark.py's own numpy texture generator (own work, no external source).
tileMetres is the script's own physical tile size (the divisor in its world-scale UV projection), not the
pixel resolution — it is what determines whether we kept 1024px or 2048px (>0.5m physical -> keep 2048).
